runs.text: We desire death. Those are their words, not mine. February two thousand and eight. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> leader Fathi Hammad, speaking on <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> television. He praised human shields. Women, children, the elderly. Then he gave the reason: we desire death like you desire life. Israel built the opposite. Every new Israeli home must have a safe room. Iron Dome shoots down rockets fired at towns. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> built tunnels under Gaza. Who were they for? October twenty twenty three. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> official Mousa Abu Marzouk answered on camera. These tunnels are meant to protect us from the airplanes. And the civilians? He said the United Nations must protect them. This is about <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>>, not the Palestinian people. Parents in Gaza want their kids to <<ˈ|l|ɪ|v>> too. So can there be peace while a leadership chooses death? Because they said it out loud.
